Toronto Street Festival Shooting Leaves 2 Dead, 3 Wounded

A mass shooting incident occurred near a Toronto street festival, resulting in the deaths of two people and injuries to three others. Police have warned of an active shooter and are searching for the attacker. The incident has raised concerns about public safety at outdoor events.
